Use the attached portrait as a bounded makeup reference and test the same observable makeup contract inside an unrelated nocturnal pollination-archive scene.

Create a photorealistic chest-up editorial portrait of an original adult nocturnal pollination archivist in a humid midnight greenhouse, cataloging bioluminescent moth dust from a microbrush onto a glass slide. Her makeup forms a restrained polished natural balance: sheer-to-light satin complexion correction leaves fine skin texture and natural tonal variation readable; softly groomed low-arch brows retain individual hairs; a neutral taupe wash is deepest at the upper lash line and diffuses through the crease; a slim interlash line ends in a very short tapered outer extension; lashes are clean and separated; a muted rose flush stays soft on the cheeks; muted rosy-coral lip color is strongest near the inner center, fades toward a softly diffused vermilion edge, and carries a low satin-balm sheen. Eye, cheek, and lip contrast remain mutually restrained so the complexion leads the hierarchy. Use a soft neutral facial key while blue-green specimen glow stays localized to the slide and gloves. The supplied portrait guides only this makeup placement, color distribution, and surface finish; the subject has an original facial identity.

render_gates.description: The image visibly commits to one identifiable source medium or protocol rather than an unspecified digital mood.
Artifacts share one technically coherent failure family native to the selected medium or protocol.
A deliberate bounded rupture is compositionally legible instead of uniform decorative noise across the whole frame.
Enough subject and scene continuity survives across the break for the failed flow to remain perceptible.
The result is not carried by generic RGB separation, random static, scanlines, VHS texture, or unrelated effect stacking alone.

Without prompt text, a caption, or metadata, a viewer can infer the selected source-medium failure mechanism from the same fingerprint repeated at three or more separated image locations; merely noticing that the image looks broken fails.
Malformed anatomy, fused objects, broken text, muddy texture, or one isolated synthesis defect does not carry the intended medium-native glitch.

candidates.interpreted_meaning: A visible break in one identified image, video, signal, or file process exposes that medium's own technological structure through one coherent family of mechanism-native artifacts while the underlying subject remains partly continuous and recognizable.
meaning_components: one identified image video signal or file process

candidates.interpreted_meaning: A coherent applied makeup system whose readable sheer-to-light satin complexion leads the hierarchy while low-contrast brow, neutral eye, muted cheek, and centered soft lip treatments remain individually visible and mutually restrained.
